description: This file defines the 'FieldDescription' class and the 'IFieldDescription' interface within the Orleans.CodeGenerator namespace. The class models metadata about a field, including its type, identifier, and related symbols, and provides methods for type syntax conversion. It is used in code generation scenarios within the Orleans framework.

classes.name: FieldDescription
classes.description: Represents metadata about a field, including its ID, type, symbol, and syntax representation, used in code generation within Orleans.

classes.name: IFieldDescription
classes.description: Interface defining the contract for field description metadata, including access to the underlying field symbol.

methods.name: FieldDescription
methods.description: Constructor initializing a FieldDescription instance with field ID, primary constructor parameter flag, and field symbol.

methods.name: GetTypeSyntax
methods.description: Returns the TypeSyntax representation of a given ITypeSymbol.
